excerpt: Top Reasons LMIA-Based Work Permit Applications Get Refused by IRCC Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Receiving a refusal letter from Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) can be discouraging, especially if you’ve invested time, money, and hope into your application. Whether you applied for a study permit, work permit, visitor visa, or permanent residence, it is important to remember that a refusal is not necessarily the end of the road. In many cases, it’s the first step in reassessing, improving, and reapplying with stronger documentation and clearer intent.
author: Anuj Sengar
